module: Builds a route's breadcrumb for the router. For a non-global route, it optionally adds a module decorator at the head, then one crumb per node of the route chain (label, abstract, isMinorRoute, routeName, params). Titles can be static (string or non-dynamic table) or dynamic (source function called with the parameters, with fallback value).
notes: A dynamic title: {mode="dynamic", source=<function reference>, paramKey?, fallback?}. If paramKey is set, only params[paramKey] is passed to the source, otherwise the whole params table. A nil or empty value gives fallback.

The decorator: the one provided, otherwise (if visible) the module's configuration via ui_router_routeManager.getModuleDecorator, in dynamic mode (source called with params, fallback config.fallback) or static ({label}). It is added as the first crumb with decorator=true and routeName=nil.
A route with global = true has no crumb.

buildBreadcrumbs.desc: Builds the list of crumbs for a route: optional decorator then one crumb per node returned by ui_router_routeManager.getRouteNodes(routename).

decorator.desc: Already resolved decorator (otherwise computed if the decorator is visible).

returns.desc: Crumbs {label, abstract, isMinorRoute, routeName, params}; the decorator is {label, routeName=nil, decorator=true}.

setDecoratorVisible.desc: Shows or hides the decorator in the breadcrumb (delegates to NavigationState.setDecoratorVisible).

isDecoratorVisible.desc: Indicates whether the decorator is visible (NavigationState.isDecoratorVisible).
